context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. IMPORTANT: export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL before pytest (otherwise the test file's hardcoded fallback URL points to a stale preview and every test 404s). Use: `export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) && pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py`. pytest.ini already pins -n 2 --dist loadscope; do NOT pass extra -n.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs. Initial local pytest run showed 404s because REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL was not exported in shell env, so the test module fell back to an outdated hardcoded URL (toko-rekap-system.preview.emergentagent.com). After exporting the correct URL from /app/frontend/.env, all 44 tests passed.
